desc:
A Flutter app redesign and UI refresh gives your existing app a cleaner, more modern interface on iPhone and Android in one pass. Ecom Swift LLC designs the new look, rebuilds the screens and keeps your features, accounts and data as they are.

## Why can a Flutter app be redesigned in one pass?

Flutter draws every element of the interface itself, instead of using each system's built-in controls. A theme, a button style or a spacing rule defined once therefore appears the same on both platforms. A redesign changes the shared widgets and screens, and both apps change together.

That is the main reason to redesign in Flutter. You are not paying for one design on iOS and a second one on Android, and the two apps stop drifting apart.

## What an outdated interface costs you

Users judge an app within moments. Crowded screens, inconsistent buttons, hard-to-read text and confusing navigation signal that nobody cares, and that doubt spreads to the product itself. People abandon forms they cannot follow, miss features they cannot find and leave reviews about how the app feels.

Internally, a patchwork design is expensive. Every screen was styled by a different person at a different time, so each change takes longer and breaks something else. Developers copy styles instead of reusing them, and the problem grows.

## How a redesign affects results

A redesign improves results through clarity and consistency. When primary actions are obvious, spacing gives the eye a path and text is readable, people complete tasks with less effort. Simplified navigation helps them find features that already existed but went unused.

A shared theme and a small set of reusable widgets also cut future cost. Adding a screen means assembling known parts, so new work looks right from the start. We cannot promise a particular lift in usage or ratings, because that depends on your product and your audience. What we can promise is a more coherent, maintainable interface that is tested on real screens.

## What a strong Flutter redesign includes

- A review of current flows and the points where users hesitate.
- A defined theme: color palette, type scale, spacing and corner styles.
- Reusable widgets for buttons, cards, inputs and lists.
- Redesigned screens shared with you as mockups for approval before building.
- Dark mode support where the package includes it.
- Refreshed onboarding screens and an updated app icon.
- Layouts checked on small phones, large phones and different text sizes.
- An accessibility pass for text size, contrast and tap targets.
- Considered motion: transitions and small animations that guide attention.
- Design files and a short guide to the theme, so your team can keep it consistent.

## How we redesign your app

We start by using your app and noting what works, what confuses and what looks inconsistent. We then present new designs for the agreed screens, in the form of before and after mockups, and revise them with you until they are approved.

After approval, we rebuild each screen in Flutter using a central theme and shared widgets. Your accounts, features, data and API stay as they are, so the update behaves like any normal release. We test the new version on real phones and also as an update from your current app version, so existing users do not lose their place or settings. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in how many screens are covered, whether dark mode and a widget library are included and how far we go on navigation and polish. If your brand guidelines exist, we follow them.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Share your brand colors, fonts and any guidelines at the start.
- Tell us which screens users spend the most time on.
- Approve mockups before building begins, not afterward.
- Keep the design simple and let your content lead.
- Check the result on the oldest and smallest phone you support.

**Avoid:**
- Changing the layout of familiar screens without a reason.
- Using tiny text or low contrast to look elegant.
- Mixing several visual styles inside one app.
- Adding animation that slows down tasks.
- Redesigning and adding major features in the same release.

## Who this service is for

An app owner whose product works but looks dated next to competitors. A team that has grown its app screen by screen and now has no consistent style. A business that has rebranded and needs the app to match the website and the stores.

## What we need from you

Access to the source code as a collaborator, your logo and brand files, and a list of the screens in scope. If you have analytics or user feedback, share what shows where people struggle. We never ask for passwords. After you order, we reply with a short checklist and share designs before any rebuilding starts.
